# Turn your sources into cited AI answers.

Connect your website, GitHub Discussions, and internal sources. Answer through widget, Slack, and API in minutes.

## Crawl, sync, or upload — one project index.

Crawl your website, sync Markdown from a GitHub repo, or upload PDFs and files. Knoku brings public and internal sources into one cited index for your widget, Slack, and API.

Website crawl Point Knoku at any public docs site and keep the index fresh on a schedule — no framework lock-in.

GitHub sync Connect a GitHub repo and sync Markdown docs into your index — kept current on each commit, with citations back to the file on GitHub.

### GitHub

Sync discussions, issues, and PRs from selected GitHub repos.

### Notion

Sync internal runbooks and CS macros from selected Notion pages.

### Confluence

Sync runbooks and internal docs from a Confluence space.

### Jira

Index known issues and release context from selected Jira tickets.

### Zendesk Help Center

Sync Help Center articles from selected sections into Documents.

### OpenAPI

Index a hosted OpenAPI or Swagger schema so the assistant knows your endpoints.
